SHOW CAUSE NOTICE UNDER SECTION 73 OF THE CGST ACT 2017
Notice Ref: SCN/MH/2023/606 Dated 18-09-2023
GSTIN: 27IIIJJ1234I1Z9 M/s Vantage Logistics Pvt Ltd
FY: 2022-23

1. Issue 1: Scrutiny of GSTR-3B vs GSTR-2B static statement for FY 2022-23 reveals that taxpayer availed ITC of Rs. 1,50,000/- in respect of invoices not reflected in GSTR-2B in violation of Section 16(2)(aa).
2. Issue 2: Taxpayer delayed filing GSTR-3B for September 2022 by 30 days. Interest under Section 50 amounting to Rs. 30,000/- is demanded on gross tax liability instead of net cash ECL balance.
